errors.name: FeeTooHigh
errors.msg: Fee rate or allowance above the program's constant cap

errors.name: NotUpgradeAuthority
errors.msg: Only the program upgrade authority can initialize

errors.name: BadAppState
errors.msg: App is in the wrong state for this instruction

errors.name: NotAProgram
errors.msg: Account is not an executable program

errors.name: BadAppAuthority
errors.msg: App authority is not the app program's zol-app address

errors.name: BadAttestation
errors.msg: Previous instruction is not a matching Ed25519 attestation

errors.name: OverCap
errors.msg: Deposit would exceed the app's cap

errors.name: PayoutCommitmentMismatch
errors.msg: Payout commitment differs from this balance's

errors.name: BadPotState
errors.msg: Pot is in the wrong state

errors.name: NoSeat
errors.msg: Player has no seat in this pot

errors.name: ReceiptMismatch
errors.msg: Expected players and buy-ins differ from the receipt

errors.name: PotNotReturned
errors.msg: Pot has not returned from the rollup

errors.name: PotInvalid
errors.msg: Pot does not match its receipt

errors.name: NotExiting
errors.msg: Balance is not marked for exit

errors.name: BadPayoutCount
errors.msg: Nothing to settle, or too many payouts

errors.name: OutOfOrder
errors.msg: Settlement is not the next unpaid one

errors.name: BadDenomination
errors.msg: Deposit amount is not a permitted denomination

fields.name: authority
docs: The app program's address with seed `zol-app`; signs on the app's behalf.

fields.name: genesis_head
docs: Note commitment (cmx) of the vault's genesis head.

fields.name: deposit_cap
docs: Credits are refused once liability plus unpaid would exceed this.

fields.name: liability
docs: sum(Balance.amount) + sum(live PotReceipt.total)

fields.name: credited_total
docs: sum(Deposit.amount) over credited deposits

fields.name: attestor
docs: FROST Ed25519 group key of the attestors.

fields.name: network
docs: Zcash network, as `zol_wire::Network`.

fields.name: id
docs: The deposit ID this account is keyed by, stored so indexers can list deposits.

fields.name: index
docs: Position among this app's credited deposits; meaningless when voided.

fields.name: digest
docs: Digest the attestors signed (credit or void).

fields.name: refund_grace_secs
docs: Must exceed the longest commit-to-return time of MagicBlock.

fields.name: registration_bond
docs: Lamports moved into the App account at registration.

fields.name: denominations
docs: Permitted deposit values in zatoshi; 0 marks an unused slot. The single
source for the gateway's decisions and for apps (e.g. coin-flip stakes).

fields.name: app_authority
docs: Copy of `App.authority`, so rollup instructions need no undelegated account.

fields.name: delegated
docs: Set at delegation; only then may seats move.

fields.name: validator
docs: Rollup validator named at delegation; the delegation program accepts commits
only from it, so it is trusted for this pot's outcome.

types.name: SeatStake
docs: One expected stake passed to `delegate_pot`.
